entries.title: Forgotten particle could answer mystery of why we exist, say physicists
entries.summary: Scientists have unveiled a new theory on the birth of the cosmos, suggesting the early universe was shaped by an ancient particle that has been overlooked for decades.

entries.title: Custom frame timing captures ultrafast events across five orders of magnitude in time
entries.summary: Most conventional methods of ultrafast photography use evenly spaced intervals in which images are taken, but new developments have shown how much can be left out of the story, especially when multiple timescales are involved.
